item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Store claims with explicit evidence scope.","mechanism":"Structured population, outcome, timeframe, and context prevent similar wording from collapsing differently scoped findings.","implementation":"Require exact stored passage IDs for every claim. Extract scope only from supplied passages; mark unspecified fields unknown rather than inferring them.","check":"Enter similar claims with different populations and opposing findings; verify separate records retain their populations, directions, and passage IDs.","risk":"Overly rigid fields may obscure qualifications; retain passage wording."},{"action":"Show disagreement separately from scope differences.","mechanism":"Pairwise evidence relationships distinguish comparable opposition, differently scoped findings, and unresolved comparability without ranking source truth.","implementation":"Add a comparison view with scope columns and user-confirmed relationship labels. Treat absent evidence as unassessed, never opposing evidence.","check":"Different-population opposing claims must display scope differences; same-scope opposing claims must display disagreement. An empty evidence slot must remain unassessed.","risk":"Incomplete scope can mislead comparisons; default uncertain pairs to unresolved."},{"action":"Compile briefings through a citation-and-scope gate.","mechanism":"Statement-level validation blocks unsupported generalization and makes relevant disagreement visible instead of smoothing it away.","implementation":"Draft only from supplied passages. Require exact passage IDs per statement, scope confirmation, and acknowledgment of linked opposition before export.","check":"Attempt an all-populations conclusion from opposing population-specific claims; block export until separate scoped statements appear with their supporting IDs.","risk":"Validation cannot establish truth; users must review semantic support."},{"action":"Keep original passages beside the working briefing.","mechanism":"An embedded source inspector preserves report context while users verify citations and compare conflicting passages.","implementation":"Open citation IDs in a workspace side panel showing exact stored text, report identity, and stored passage order; allow two passages side-by-side.","check":"From each opposing briefing statement, open its cited passage without navigation away; verify displayed text matches the stored ID exactly.","risk":"Unavailable surrounding text must be marked unavailable, not reconstructed."}],"abstention_reason":""}
